frontier.hypothesis: A THIRD producer of a surviving loop-2 preheader copy exists whose blocking condition is NOT a set of the copy's source - that assumption is the single thing both measured families share, and it is exactly what costs the pointer/links pseudo fusion (E-s23-2) or the out-of-block use instruction (V1's loop 1).
frontier.mechanism: combine's can_combine_p has seven refusal paths (s17's E-s17-1). Only use_crosses_set_p has now been built. The remaining live question is whether any of the three s17 called 'structurally unreachable' becomes reachable on the Q10 chassis, where the preheader's insn stream is already exact - s17 evaluated them on V1, whose loop-2 preheader had no copy at all, so 'unreachable' was judged against a different block shape.
frontier.next_probe: Re-read tools/gcc-2.7.2/combine.c:803-970 with Q10's .combine dump open (tmp/grind/func_80017848/dumps/ings.combine, cell Q10 is the one whose insn stream is exact) and identify WHICH path actually fired for each preheader copy - this session inferred use_crosses_set_p from behaviour and did not read the refusal. If a different path fired, s17's enumeration was priced against the wrong predicate and the three 'unreachable' paths must be re-scored on this chassis.

frontier.hypothesis: The links value can be given its own pseudo while still supplying the set of the copy's source, if the set's value is consumed inside the PREHEADER (not the body), so the carried pointer dies before the loop and stops conflicting with base.
frontier.mechanism: The conflict that kills the family (E-s23-2) is p's liveness through the loop body. If p is set to links and links is consumed into a separate local inside the preheader, p dies at that consumption, base can reuse its register, and the loop body reads the separate local. The cost is one extra insn unless the consumption folds onto target's fourth preheader instruction (addu v0,a0,v1, the base+i element pointer).
frontier.next_probe: On the Q10 chassis, write the preheader as `q = p; p = *(u8 **)(ctx + 0x10); lnk = p; base = (u8 *)(sh + (s32)q);` with the body reading lnk, and measure; then the variant with the element-pointer expression written so GCC's strength reduction has to place the copy consumption on target's `addu v0,a0,v1` slot. Read .lreg's per-register header for p and base to confirm whether the conflict disappeared before scoring.

frontier.hypothesis: The allocno-priority instrument (E-s23-3) can close residuals whose ONLY defect is register identity, on this function's siblings and elsewhere in the queue, without any spelling search.
frontier.mechanism: floor_log2(n_refs)*n_refs/live_length is computed from .lreg's per-register header; splitting a variable lowers its priority (fewer refs, shorter range) and fusing uses raises it, moving find_reg's assignment order deterministically.
frontier.next_probe: Before any further cell sweep on this function, compute the priority table for V1 (the floor body) from a .lreg dump and check whether ANY split/fuse changes the allocation at all - V1's registers already match target, so the expected answer is no, and confirming that cheaply tells the next session the instrument is only useful on the Q10-family chassis. Then carry the instrument to the next queue item with a register-identity-only residual.
